title: Microsoft Purview: protect data sent to unmanaged cloud apps through the Island Enterprise Browser
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, administrator-controlled default, licensing requirements and documented commands are supported. Two policy-creation paths omit intermediate scoping steps, and the checklist recommends action settings that are not represented in the controls table; these are minor corrections.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an automation operation to enable the Island integration.

claims.claim: The printed new-DLP-policy path reaches Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers.
claims.quote: Select + Add cloud apps. Select the Adaptive app scopes tab ... Select Edit scope ... On the Choose where to enforce the policy page, ensure Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers is On
claims.fix: The printed steps are correct but omit the cloud-app and group scope selection. For the cited scenario, give: Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Inline web traffic > Custom > Custom policy > + Add cloud apps > Adaptive app scopes > All unmanaged AI apps > Edit scope > Include only specific > + Add inclusions > Specific users and groups > group > Choose where to enforce the policy > Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-create-policy-ai-network-data-security.

claims.claim: Security & Compliance PowerShell supports New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name <String> -EnforcementPlanes @("Network") to create a network-plane policy container.
claims.quote: The EnforcementPlanes parameter defines the layer where policy actions are run. This parameter uses the following syntax: -EnforcementPlanes @("<Value>"). Valid values are: ... Network

claims.claim: Some features in the cited network DLP scenario are in preview.
claims.quote: Some features used in this scenario are in preview.

claims.claim: The printed collection-policy path reaches the Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers option.
claims.quote: Leave the default option of Don't capture content and select Next. ... Ensure Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers is enabled and select Next.
claims.fix: Expand the correct but abbreviated scenario route to: Data loss prevention > Classifiers > Collection policies > + Create policy > + Add condition > Content contains > Classifiers > Edit > Scope for classifiers > Exclude classifiers > + Exclude classifiers > Choose Classifiers > classifiers > + Add activities > activities > + Add data source > Unmanaged cloud apps > cloud apps > Edit scope > Include only specific > Included > + Add inclusions > group > Don't capture content > Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers. Lower-case placeholders identify the classifiers, activities, apps and group the administrator chooses. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/collection-policies-create-deploy-policy.
